description: Every zcxy-dev repository's dependency updates: extend github>zcxy-dev/renovate-config

packageRules.description: config:best-practices waits three days for npm releases; every repository waits seven
Patch and minor updates merge on their own once the required checks pass, through GitHub's auto-merge

Docker tags carry the date of their last push, not of their release, and official images are rebuilt under the same tag every few days, so a seven-day wait would hold every image back for good: image updates skip it and still pass the checks

Node moves in one pull request everywhere it is named (the Docker image, .node-version, mise, engines), so files that must match never land apart; without the wait, since the Docker image never comes of age and the group would never complete
The Python interpreter moves in one pull request everywhere it is named (.python-version, the python image, mise), without the wait for the same reason as Node
A Python minor changes the interpreter the code runs on: it waits for approval on the dashboard, like every major
A Playwright update needs the matching browser image and new screenshot baselines, so the packages and the image move together and never hold back the other updates
OpenNext supports a narrow range of Next.js versions, so Next.js, its @next packages and OpenNext move in one pull request

The shared workflows' pins (uses: zcxy-dev/dotfiles/.github/workflows/<name>.yml@<sha> # workflows-vX.Y.Z) move to every new release together, a major too, without the seven-day wait, since the releases are our own
